_note: Spec values must match the table in specs.md; compose.py checks this. top_speed drives the 0-300 bar. refs_dir holds side/front/rear/front34.jpg reference photos (credits.json lists the sources; the F40's are not in the repo). art lists the generated images compose.py uses: hero is a whole-poster candidate from generate.py (hero_from_poster: the hero band is cut from it) or a side view; front and rear come from generate.py --view. title is the make, set as the headline; maker_line is 'MODEL · YEAR' below it.

cars.title: CHEVROLET
cars.colors: Accelerate Yellow Metallic paint (a bright, slightly greenish yellow) with black lower trim

cars.title: FORD
cars.colors: Blue Ember Metallic paint (a deep steel blue) with dark grey wheels and blue brake calipers
cars.details: long hood with vents, darkened trapezoid grille, slim dark headlights, three vertical red light bars in each taillight, fixed rear wing, quad exhaust; plain production car with no roof light bar, no stickers and no pace-car equipment

cars.title: DODGE

cars.title: PORSCHE

cars.title: LAMBORGHINI

cars.title: FERRARI
